sources.snippet: The framework isn't a game engine and isn't a single generation model — it's a structured skill and pipeline system designed for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI). The agent learns what generation models to call, what asset formats to produce, and how to integrate outputs into a target engine.
